summary: The fix is minimal and correct: ApplyRefund now reverses Prorate(c.FXFeeMinor, refundMinor, c.AmountMinor) instead of the whole FX fee. Prorate uses integer arithmetic with half-even rounding, as the issue requires, and a full refund (refundMinor == AmountMinor) still reverses the whole fee. The previously failing TestApplyRefund cases cover the change.
